definitions: The kneecap; a small, flat, triangular bone in front of the knee joint, protecting the joint and providing leverage for the thigh muscles.
A genus of true limpets, marine gastropod molluscs in the family Patellidae.
examples: The doctor examined the patient's patella.
A fractured patella can be very painful.
The patella is an important part of the knee.
The limpet's shell, a patella, clung tightly to the rock.
